title: 4 pk孙翔，被围观
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

手机买了，最高配苹果新机，再加充电器耳机，价格五位数，孙翔付款眼也不眨。

包没买，孙翔冲进lv旗舰店之前周珈蓝及时拉住了他。

“不喜欢这个？隔壁还有其他家，”商场一长排奢侈品店铺一溜排开，孙翔指了指，意气风发，又土又豪，“诺，挑！”

“……不是，不买包，去打竞技场。”

于是俩人转战网吧，孙翔熟门熟路停车上楼进包厢，插卡开机。

周珈蓝默默坐下，也跟着插卡开机，她裙子没有兜，卡是从旧手机壳里拿出来的。

阿茜娜被战队拿走做装备升级了，她现在拿的是战队让她临时用的小号，少女狂剑“美杜莎”，上线。

孙翔已经开好了房间，他拿的也是狂剑士，id“横枪”，金发碧眼冷白皮肤，戴着铁面罩挡住下半张脸，像孤身冒险的古典主义希腊英雄。

地图是落日沙场，残阳如血，漫天黄沙，障碍物不多，一根孤立的石柱，几片断壁残垣，以及几驾废弃倒地的战车残骸。

3，2，1。

倒计时清零，“美杜莎”率先冲锋，白色重铠哗哗作响，像一道白色闪电撕开黑色战场。

孙翔当然不退，他的狂剑向来以一往无前闻名，横枪悍然硬上，重剑对重剑，风声中漫天黄沙扬起，剑气凄厉。

美杜莎借反震力侧身滑步，重剑从横枪的剑刃上划过，擦出一蓬火花，不是后退又是前进，少女狂剑半步屈膝上前，剑刃直指横枪侧肋。

孙翔越打越兴奋，美杜莎的打法是非常正统的狂剑士打法，剑对剑，硬碰硬，没有策略，没有战术，两眼一闭就是硬冲。

孙翔当然不会怕！两人硬碰硬换血，无论操作还是走位都登峰造极，连招丝滑落在对面身上，己方和对方身上同步炸开大蓬大蓬的血花。

血量狂掉。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

I bought a mobile phone, up to a new Apple model, plus a charger and earphones, for a five-digit price, and Sun Xiang paid without blinking an eye.

Without buying the bag, Zhou Jialan caught Sun Xiang in time before he rushed into the LV flagship store.

"Don't like this? There are other stores next door," Sun Xiang pointed at a long row of luxury stores in the shopping mall, high-spirited, rich and wealthy, "No, take your pick!"

"...No, don't buy a bag, just go to the arena."

So the two of them moved to the Internet cafe. Sun Xiang stopped the car and went upstairs to the box, inserted the card and turned on the phone.

Zhou Jialan sat down silently and inserted the card to turn on the phone. There was no pocket in her skirt and the card was taken out of the old mobile phone case.

Athena was taken away by the team to upgrade her equipment. She is now holding the trumpet that the team asked her to use temporarily, the girl's mad sword "Medusa", which is now online.

Sun Xiang has already opened the room. He is also a mad swordsman with an ID of "Horizontal Spear". He has blond hair, blue eyes and cold white skin. He wears an iron mask to cover the lower half of his face. He looks like a classic Greek hero who is adventuring alone.

The map is a sunset battlefield, the setting sun is like blood, the sky is full of yellow sand, there are not many obstacles, an isolated stone pillar, a few broken walls, and the remains of a few abandoned and fallen chariots.

3, 2, 1.

The countdown was cleared, and "Medusa" took the lead in charging. The white heavy armor rustled, tearing open the black battlefield like a white lightning.

Of course, Sun Xiang would not retreat. His mad sword was always famous for its indomitable force. The horizontal spear was fiercely thrust forward, the epee faced the epee, the yellow sand in the sky was rising in the wind, and the sword energy was fierce.

Medusa took advantage of the force of the shock and slid sideways. The heavy sword passed across the blade of Hengqiang, causing a burst of sparks. Instead of retreating, she advanced. The girl's crazy sword bent her knees and stepped forward, with the blade pointed directly at the side of Hengqiang.

Sun Xiang became more and more excited as he fought. Medusa's fighting style was a very orthodox mad swordsman style. Sword to sword, head-on confrontation. There was no strategy or tactics. She just closed her eyes and charged head-on.

Of course Sun Xiang won't be afraid!The two of them had a head-to-head exchange of blood, both in operation and positioning. They were at their best, and their combos landed on the opponent's body smoothly, causing large amounts of blood to explode simultaneously on both their own body and the opponent's body.

The blood volume is crazy.
